name: Clarence Chatham Cook
bio: Clarence Chatham Cook (1828–1900) was an American art critic, born in Dorchester, Massachusetts. He edited The Studio of New York and published "The Central Park" (1868) and "The House Beautiful" (1877).
His poem on a death in spring appears in Stedman's An American Anthology (1900).

poems.title: On One Who Died in May
poems.author: Clarence Chatham Cook
